description: Get one product by its code: available sizes, fabrics, the price of each size+fabric variant, and the design's 'about' text. Call it before add_to_cart when the human hasn't picked a size yet or may want another fabric — a search card doesn't list them. code is the `code` field of a search_products card (the end of its /p/<code> url); add_to_cart then takes the numeric good_id, which this result also returns. Read-only; an unknown code returns error 'product not found'.
name: get_product

error.description: Present when the product was not found.

title: Get product details
